title.narrative: Nigeria COVID-19 Preparedness and Response Project

description.narrative: The Project Development Objective (PDO) is to prevent, detect, and respond to the threat posed by COVID-19 at state level in Nigeria.

This Project Appraisal Document (PAD) describes the emergency response to Nigeria under the COVID-19 Strategic Preparedness And Response Program (SPRP) using the Multiphase Programmatic Approach (MPA), approved by the World Bank's Board of Executive Directors on April 2, 2020 with an overall Program financing envelope of International Development Association (IDA) US$1.3 billion and of International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) US$2.7 billion. This project is prepared under the global framework of the World Bank COVID-19 Response financed under the Fast Track COVID-19 Facility (FCTF) and Nigeria IDA19 allocation
